messages.context: Captain Ahone：In the  Mage Council, after the meeting
messages.text: Our relations with the Piglins is getting worse, things are spiraling out of control.
messages.gloss: 社区 Wiki 普通页面原文；尚未实机逐字核对。
messages.zh: 我们与 猪灵 的关系越来越糟,局势已经快失控了。

messages.context: Captain Ahone：First Interaction in the  Burning DesertAfter Being Sent by  Dean
messages.text: You are looking for the Dean's Apprentice?
messages.gloss: 社区 Wiki 普通页面原文；尚未实机逐字核对。
messages.zh: 你在找院长的学徒?

messages.context: Captain Ahone：First Interaction in the  Burning DesertAfter Being Sent by  Dean
messages.text: I'm afraid he might be in great danger, I just found his backpack and there is some blood on it...
messages.gloss: 社区 Wiki 普通页面原文；尚未实机逐字核对。
messages.zh: 恐怕他正身陷险境。我刚找到他的背包,上面还有血迹……

messages.context: Captain Ahone：First Interaction in the  Burning DesertAfter Being Sent by  Dean
messages.text: We must find him at once, I really hope this isn't the Piglin's doing.
messages.gloss: 社区 Wiki 普通页面原文；尚未实机逐字核对。
messages.zh: 我们必须立刻找到他。真希望这不是 猪灵 干的。

messages.context: Captain Ahone：First Interaction in the  Burning DesertAfter Being Sent by  Dean
messages.text: Let's separate. Take my contact and call me if you find anything.
messages.gloss: 社区 Wiki 普通页面原文；尚未实机逐字核对。
messages.zh: 我们分头行动。保存我的联系方式,一有发现就打给我。

messages.context: Captain Ahone：Looking for the  Apprentice
messages.text: He might be nearby, let me know if you find anything.
messages.gloss: 社区 Wiki 普通页面原文；尚未实机逐字核对。
messages.zh: 他应该就在附近,有任何发现立刻告诉我。

messages.context: Captain Ahone：Calling with an Abiphone  After Finding Apprentice
messages.text: ✆ You found the Apprentice?
messages.gloss: 社区 Wiki 普通页面原文；尚未实机逐字核对。
messages.zh: ✆ 你找到学徒了?

messages.context: Captain Ahone：Calling with an Abiphone  After Finding Apprentice
messages.text: ✆ Good work. We will come to you at once!
messages.gloss: 社区 Wiki 普通页面原文；尚未实机逐字核对。
messages.zh: ✆ 干得好,我们马上赶过去!

messages.context: Captain Ahone：After Help Arrives
messages.text: Looks like we found him just in time, he will live, but he needs medical attention.
messages.gloss: 社区 Wiki 普通页面原文；尚未实机逐字核对。
messages.zh: 看来我们来得正是时候。他能活下来,但必须马上接受治疗。

messages.context: Captain Ahone：After Help Arrives
messages.text: I know the Dean's Apprentice, they would never take that much damage from the monsters around here.
messages.gloss: 社区 Wiki 普通页面原文；尚未实机逐字核对。
messages.zh: 我了解院长的学徒,附近这些怪物不可能把他伤成这样。

messages.context: Captain Ahone：After Help Arrives
messages.text: Once they wake up from their coma we will know what happened to them, but I have my suspicions.
messages.gloss: 社区 Wiki 普通页面原文；尚未实机逐字核对。
messages.zh: 等他从昏迷中醒来,我们就能知道发生了什么。不过我心里已经有了猜测。

messages.context: Captain Ahone：After Help Arrives
messages.text: The guards and I will bring him back to the city, please explain the situation to the Dean.
messages.gloss: 社区 Wiki 普通页面原文；尚未实机逐字核对。
messages.zh: 我和卫兵会把他送回城里,请你去向院长说明情况。

messages.context: Captain Ahone：After giving  Dean his resources  (Can appear as Abiphone dialogue)
messages.text: %s! Perfect timing
messages.gloss: 社区 Wiki 普通页面原文；尚未实机逐字核对。
messages.zh: %s! 你来得正好。

messages.context: Captain Ahone：After giving  Dean his resources  (Can appear as Abiphone dialogue)
messages.text: Our entire stash of Sulphur got stolen. I have no idea how "they" did it.
messages.gloss: 社区 Wiki 普通页面原文；尚未实机逐字核对。
messages.zh: 我们储备的硫磺全被偷了。我完全不知道“他们”是怎么做到的。

messages.context: Captain Ahone：After giving  Dean his resources  (Can appear as Abiphone dialogue)
messages.text: The Queen is warning me against hasty conclusions, but enough is enough.
messages.gloss: 社区 Wiki 普通页面原文；尚未实机逐字核对。
messages.zh: 女王告诫我不要妄下结论,可忍耐也该有个限度。

messages.context: Captain Ahone：After giving  Dean his resources  (Can appear as Abiphone dialogue)
messages.text: We cannot let the Barbarians trespass our borders without retaliation.
messages.gloss: 社区 Wiki 普通页面原文；尚未实机逐字核对。
messages.zh: 野蛮人胆敢越过边境,我们绝不能毫无回应。

messages.context: Captain Ahone：After giving  Dean his resources  (Can appear as Abiphone dialogue)
messages.text: My scouts told me they sighted Barbarian activities in the North, near the Forgotten Skull.
messages.gloss: 社区 Wiki 普通页面原文；尚未实机逐字核对。
messages.zh: 斥候报告说,北方 遗忘之颅 附近出现了野蛮人的踪迹。

messages.context: Captain Ahone：After giving  Dean his resources  (Can appear as Abiphone dialogue)
messages.text: Let's meet again there, and be prepared for combat.
messages.gloss: 社区 Wiki 普通页面原文；尚未实机逐字核对。
messages.zh: 我们到那里会合,做好战斗准备。

messages.context: Captain Ahone：Before heading to the  Forgotten Skull  (Can appear as Abiphone dialogue)
messages.text: The Forgotten Skull in the North is close to the Barbarian borders, they are probably hiding the stolen Sulphur there.
messages.gloss: 社区 Wiki 普通页面原文；尚未实机逐字核对。
messages.zh: 北方的 遗忘之颅 靠近野蛮人边境,他们很可能把偷来的硫磺藏在那里。

messages.context: Captain Ahone
messages.text: Some matters cannot be solved peacefully.
messages.gloss: 社区 Wiki 普通页面原文；尚未实机逐字核对。
messages.zh: 有些事没法和平解决。

messages.context: Captain Ahone：Calling with an Abiphone  After defeating Kuudra and then speaking to Dean
messages.text: ✆ Thank you for helping with the tentacle monster.
messages.gloss: 社区 Wiki 普通页面原文；尚未实机逐字核对。
messages.zh: ✆ 谢谢你帮忙对付那只触手怪。

messages.context: Captain Ahone：Calling with an Abiphone  After defeating Kuudra and then speaking to Dean
messages.text: ✆ We owe the Piglins an apology.
messages.gloss: 社区 Wiki 普通页面原文；尚未实机逐字核对。
messages.zh: ✆ 我们欠 猪灵 一个道歉。

messages.context: Captain Ahone：Calling with an Abiphone  After defeating Kuudra and then speaking to Dean
messages.text: ✆ I will stay in Scarleton and prepare for the next battle!
messages.gloss: 社区 Wiki 普通页面原文；尚未实机逐字核对。
messages.zh: ✆ 我会留在绯红城,为下一场战斗做好准备!
